'''Kuat of Kuat''' was the hereditary title given to the head of [[House Kuat]] and [[Kuat Drive Yards/Legends|Kuat Drive Yards]]. The Kuat of Kuat heir also took on the role of [[Technician (title)|Technician]] in [[Gender/Legends|his]] management of Kuat Drive Yards. Kuat of Kuat resisted efforts from [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] and others to seize control of Kuat Drive Yards, enforcing the promise of generations of Kuat of Kuat that Kuat Drive Yards was eternal.
